title: Absolutely magnificent...
text:
Absolutely magnificent
Come in the morning at opening time. 
Stroll according to your desires, views, and scents.
author: Pascaline_K

title: The Alhambra reflects the fusion of Arab and Christian cultures. It is a fortune that it has been able to be preserved!!
text: An incredible three-hour tour; we learned about the history, the gardens, the Palace of Charles V, the Nasrid Palaces, and the hotels that are inside. The Viator guide's explanation was clear, organized, and very informative.  A magical place!!
author: StellasofiaV

title: Communication, reservations, and ticket delivery: N/A
text:
Tripadvisor does not allow booking more than 4 tickets. There were 5 of us, including my 14-year-old daughter. 
Tripadvisor scheduled 2 different times, 9:30 AM and 1:00 PM; it was impossible to have my daughter visit alone... Tripadvisor refused to change the time for the 5th ticket. 
Tripadvisor's organization is terrible, with email messages that are not tickets even though it mentions "your tickets" in the message, tickets on Apple Wallet that are only reservations... in short, a real mess and a refusal at the entrance gate.
author: K6051CThelenea

title: Very reliable for the Alhambra and the Nasridi Palaces
text: It was a wonderful experience thanks to the Heritago team. After reading the other reviews, I was a little unsure, but they turned out to be the best in this field truly reliable. Thanks again.
author: Dreamer56684708276

title: A great day at an incredible historic site.
text: We so enjoyed our day at Alhambra and Nasrid Palaces. A real insight into the beauty, architecture and culture of the distant past. Tour operator was able to offer what they promised - lastminute tickets to Nasrid. Audio guide is disappointing - brief and superficial.
author: maureengilly

title: Incredible!
text: Last-minute reservation!!!!! In bulk!!!! But a miracle, tickets for the Alhambra and especially the Nasrid Palaces! Unexpected! Incredible experience, too bad about the extra cost… it was worth it!
author: audreydB2357WB

title: We were almost ready to change our plans
text: We had already started looking for another activity instead of the Alhambra. Fortunately, we contacted this service before giving up for good. The assistance was kind, concrete, and efficient. Finally, we were able to experience the visit we had been waiting for for a long time.
author: Connector44445460421

title: The highlight of our trip
text: Granada was already beautiful, but visiting the Alhambra was the main reason we chose this destination. Finding out that tickets were sold out was a huge disappointment. Thanks to the support we received, we did not have to give up. It became one of the most memorable parts of our journey.
author: 690liboriof

title: Ideal for travelers with little time
text: We came from abroad and only had two days in Granada. We couldn't afford to spend hours looking for available tickets. The support saved us a lot of time and allowed us to enjoy our stay in a relaxed way.
author: E9807KJmattias

title: Short, clear and effective
text: I needed help and I got it. Quick communication, helpful people and easy-to-understand information. Everything was much simpler than expected.
author: marcooB6201LT
